unreal.default_reverb: Use one dark cave reverb/AudioVolume for point sources; dry sources are provided.
unreal.ambient: Two non-spatial continuous stereo beds. Enable looping on their SoundWave or sound cue.
unreal.steps: Mono; trigger from travelled distance, choose variation, attenuate companion substantially.
